# Application Kafka Management Standards

This directory contains standards for developers using Kafka management tools, troubleshooting, and monitoring from the application perspective.
page_texts.4:
[standards/application/kafka-management/README.md#std-app-kmgmt-001-topic-browser-access]

### STD-APP-KMGMT-001: Topic Browser Access

Standards for developers accessing and browsing Kafka topics using management tools including permissions, data inspection practices, and security considerations.
page_texts.5:
[standards/application/kafka-management/README.md#std-app-kmgmt-002-lsql-query-standards]

### STD-APP-KMGMT-002: LSQL Query Standards

Standards for writing Lenses SQL (LSQL) queries for real-time data inspection, transformation testing, and ad-hoc analysis.
page_texts.6:
[standards/application/kafka-management/README.md#std-app-kmgmt-003-developer-dashboards]

### STD-APP-KMGMT-003: Developer Dashboards

Standards for creating and using developer-focused Kafka dashboards including metrics, visualizations, and alerting for application teams.
page_texts.7:
[standards/application/kafka-management/README.md#std-app-kmgmt-004-api-access]

### STD-APP-KMGMT-004: API Access

Standards for programmatic access to Kafka management APIs including authentication, authorization, rate limiting, and usage patterns.
page_texts.8:
[standards/application/kafka-management/README.md#std-app-kmgmt-005-local-lenses-cli]

### STD-APP-KMGMT-005: Local Lenses CLI

Standards for using the Lenses CLI tool in local development environments including installation, configuration, and common operations.
page_texts.9:
[standards/application/kafka-management/README.md#std-app-kmgmt-006-cicd-integration]

### STD-APP-KMGMT-006: CI/CD Integration

Standards for integrating Kafka management operations into CI/CD pipelines including automated testing, topic validation, and deployment verification.
page_texts.10:
[standards/application/kafka-management/README.md#std-app-kmgmt-007-gitops-workflows]

### STD-APP-KMGMT-007: GitOps Workflows

Standards for managing Kafka resources (topics, ACLs, schemas) using GitOps principles including infrastructure-as-code, version control, and automated deployment.
page_texts.11:
[standards/application/kafka-management/README.md#std-app-kmgmt-008-consumer-lag-investigation]

### STD-APP-KMGMT-008: Consumer Lag Investigation

Standards for investigating and troubleshooting consumer lag issues including diagnostic techniques, tools to use, and remediation approaches.
page_texts.12:
[standards/application/kafka-management/README.md#std-app-kmgmt-009-topic-data-inspection]

### STD-APP-KMGMT-009: Topic Data Inspection

Standards for inspecting topic data during development and troubleshooting including sampling techniques, filtering, and data privacy considerations.
page_texts.13:
[standards/application/kafka-management/README.md#std-app-kmgmt-010-error-message-analysis]

### STD-APP-KMGMT-010: Error Message Analysis

Standards for analyzing error messages and failed events in Kafka including dead letter topic management, error pattern identification, and resolution workflows.
page_texts.14:
[standards/application/kafka-management/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

These standards ensure:
- Effective use of Kafka management tools by developers
- Consistent troubleshooting approaches
- Safe and auditable Kafka operations
- Developer productivity and self-service capabilities
- Integration with modern DevOps practices
